title: Scope
description: Structured, deterministically-matchable authorization boundary. A Verifier checks a requested action against this object with pure boolean logic — never with an LLM.

actions.description: Allow-list of action types this delegation permits, e.g. 'read_invoice', 'create_payment', 'send_message'. An action not listed here is implicitly denied.

resources.description: Allow-list of resource/system identifiers the actions may target (API name, account ID, document ID pattern). Omit to mean 'any resource', but prefer being explicit.

max_amount.description: Optional monetary/quantity ceiling, checked per single action and optionally aggregated by the Verifier's own policy.

counterparties.description: Optional allow/deny list of who the action may target or interact with.

data_categories.description: Optional allow-list of data categories the agent may read/write/transmit.

time_windows.description: Optional recurring windows during which the delegation may be exercised, in addition to valid_from/valid_until.
